prompt:

Interface: white panels, near-black (#111114) text in a clean neo-grotesque typeface, cool grey 1px hairlines, small uppercase monospace labels, one cobalt highlight on the "Add a seat" button. Visible text, spelled exactly: "Cohort starts Mon, Nov 2"; "Seats · 24 of 25 assigned"; "Add a seat". Add realistic secondary details in small grey text so it reads as a real working tool.
Around the panel, on the cobalt field: fine thin white technical drawing marks like a designer's annotated blueprint (construction lines, dimension arrows, small registration circles and crosshairs, no words), plus three or four small white four-point sparkle glints. Very soft shadow under the panel. No device frame, no browser chrome, no people, no hands, no perspective tilt, no gradients, no logos.
